event_summary: A luminous oval ring with yellow-orange and pink-purple wisps continuously changes shape and brightness against a dark background.
raw_event_description: The clip begins with an already-visible glowing oval ring near the center of a dark green-black field. The ring has a darker central opening and a brighter yellow-orange band mostly along the right and lower portions, with pink-purple translucent wisps around and inside it. Over time, the outline flickers, wisps extend and retract, the bright band shifts around the oval, and the overall shape becomes taller and then more rounded while remaining centered in the frame. Near the later portion, the upper and right portions glow more broadly, the surrounding wispy veil spreads outward, and the central dark opening remains visible.

reasons: The luminous oval is already present in the first frame.
The object boundary and central opening are visible against a dark background.
The event appears to be ongoing rather than beginning from an unaltered setup.
